rubrics.name: Long-scroll story progression
rubrics.description: Single route '/' has a very tall scroll runway (50000px desktop, 25000px on 320-480px mobile) to pace a meditative journey. First 10 viewports are intro narrative, remaining scroll drives the visualization through 18 women. Intro text and video backgrounds crossfade over a 0-3 internal timeline (first text fades out 0-0.9, second fades in 0.8-1.3, holds 1.3-2.2, fades out 2.2-2.9, whole intro layer fades 2.2-3). Once scroll passes 82% of intro distance, visualization becomes active. Scroll is native with history.scrollRestoration manual and scrollTo top on entry, maintaining 60fps via passive listeners.

rubrics.name: 3D space with floating orbs
rubrics.description: Fixed full-viewport canvas (z-index 1, inset 0, 100vw/100vh) renders an atmospheric landscape: vertical sky gradient from #192e4c zenith through #1e3558 40% and #2a446e 70% to #345488 horizon, low-poly terrain plane base #213344 with flat shading and subtle wireframe #3a556f at 0.14 opacity rotated to sit in bottom third, and 480 sparse star discs color #FFFEF5 with Gaussian distribution and random scale. 18 orbs represent women, each a 1.25 plane billboard holding 4-7 overlapping warm circles (#ffe8a0 0.78, #ffcc66 0.68, #ffb84d 0.58, #e6a040 0.48) rendered with screen blending and three alpha passes (0.05, 0.1, 0.85) and radius scales (1, 0.75, 0.5). Orbs bob vertically sin 0.35 amplitude and drift horizontally 0.22, internal circles drift via pseudo-noise for organic glow, and far orbs >15 units fade out in opacity and scale to keep center cluster readable.

rubrics.name: Scroll moves the camera within the 3D space
rubrics.description: Camera movement is entirely scroll-driven. Visualization scroll is max(0, scrollY - 10*vh) clamped to bodyScrollHeight-innerHeight-10*vh producing progress 0-1. First 1% of that progress shows wide overview with no story card; remaining 99% maps to a paused timeline where each woman gets 2 units (1 move, 1 hold) plus final 2 units pullback to z beyond maxZ+5. Camera lerps smoothly toward target above orb height looking slightly down beyond orb, scrubbed via timeline seek by progress. Landing threshold uses (progress-0.01)/0.99*(WOMEN+1) floor to determine active index, debounced 200ms to avoid flicker. Space size correlates year to depth and backlinks to height/size (0.4-1.0), so scroll feels like flying forward in time through the field.

rubrics.name: Text of each woman associated with each orb
rubrics.description: When camera settles, fixed centered story card appears (50%/50% translate -50% -50%, max-width 340px, padding 24px, color #0b1e38 with glow text-shadow 0 0 12px rgba(255,254,245,0.6) and 0 0 24px rgba(255,254,245,0.3)). Card shows year e.g. 1984 as 1.25em weight 700 bordered bottom inline-block, name e.g. Grace Hopper 1.5em up to clamp(1.5rem,3.8vw,2.3rem) weight 700 line-height 1.15, fields italic 0.85rem opacity 0.9, shortSummary line-height 1.6, and link 'read more' arrow to Wikipedia url opening in new tab. Visibility follows per-orb local timeline: hidden 0-0.5, fade in 0.5-0.7, hold 0.7-1.7, fade out 1.7-1.9 using fadeSlideIn keyframes opacity 0 translate -45% to opacity 1 -50% 0.6-0.9s ease-out restarted by key change per woman. Progress pill fixed bottom 24px left 50% translateX -50% shows e.g. '5 of 18' aria-live polite, background rgba(11,30,56,0.6) blur 8px border 1px rgba(255,254,245,0.15) radius 20px 0.85rem letter-spacing 0.05em opacity 0.6.

rubrics.name: Atmospheric intro with video crossfade and outro closure
rubrics.description: Intro layer fixed z-index 5 100vw/100vh holds two full-cover videos: /videos/fancy_reduced.mp4 and /videos/timelapse_reduced.mp4 (autoplay muted loop playsInline, min-width 100vw min-height 100vh centered translate -50% -50% pointer-events none opacity transition 0.3s ease). Pattern overlay /images/bg-pattern.png covers intro at 0.3 opacity decorative non-interactive. Text block 600px centered 40vh 50vw translate -50% -50% justified line-height 2 with title 'One Amongst Many' 2em weight 700, byline 0.85em with links to cdacanay.com, tina.pizza, sxywu.com, and editorial paragraphs about history and installation legend, plus bounce cue at bottom 80px 3em with keyframes bounce 0% translateY 0 50% -20px 100% 0 duration 1.5s ease-in-out infinite. After final orb pullback, outro panel fixed top 50vh left 50vw translate -50% -50% min-content width centered z-index 20 appears over 0.5 timeline opacity 0->1, containing YouTube iframe https://www.youtube.com/embed/bEM0CRdCrQo (854x480 desktop, 340x240 on 320-480px mobile), heading 'Read more about One Amongst Many here:', three credit links, footer 'Made with love in Brooklyn, 2019.' 0.85em italic. Reduced-motion disables bounce and fadeSlideIn.
